📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
This is occurrence #34 in the last 7 days (37 total since 2026-05-23).

DD monitor 115456700 *RTC Screen Load has a high p95 latency* re-fired in #alert-system. Spike confirmed: `p95 trace.aspnet_core.request{service:runtime-core-api,resource_name:post_/api/v1/runtime/load/_screenid*}` peaked at **10.08s @ 12:03:20Z** (vs 3s threshold, ratio 2.36×), recovered to <2s within ~40s. Zero error logs on `service:runtime-core-api status:error env:prod` in window — canonical latency-only ki-24 signature.

No deploys: `runtime-core` HEAD `1f179c6d2` unchanged since 2026-05-06 (26 days). Not a code regression.

*Playbook:* (1) confirm latency-only via DD logs (zero errors ✅), (2) inspect outlier traces in spike window for slow span (SQL/Mongo/Redis), (3) tag breakdown by `@account_name` / per-tenant DB. (4) Mitigation options pending root cause: bump threshold to 4s (mask), add per-resource circuit breaker (medium), or profile slowest accounts and index-fix (root). Open Jira: none.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence #62 in the last 7 days (90 total since 2026-05-20). **Resurfacing via every-10th-occurrence gate** (occ 90 % 10 == 0) — 24h known-issue-window would have otherwise suppressed.

DD monitor 77419271 *Unusual number of XHR errors for account* re-fired in #alert-frontend-errors twice this cycle:
  • G_A 13:13:12Z + sat 13:15:12Z (occ 89, suppressed by 24h window)
  • G_B 13:49:13Z + sat 13:52:13Z (occ 90, this DM)
Monitor last_triggered_ts 2026-06-01T13:52:11Z = exact G_B sat ts match. Canonical ki-21 paths confirmed via ES regex: `/preferences/v3/feature-flags/evaluate`, `/syncutil/syncwidget/{account}/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync`, `/preferences/v3/Account`, `/account/learning/progress` — all microservices.method.int Tier-3 IIS pool.

ES chronic-baseline: 724 RequestTimedOutError hits in 13:10–13:55Z window vs same-window prior-day samples {20, 63, 778, 185} (median 124). Today is 5.8× 4-day median but **well below 72h-ago peak (778)** — within historical burst-band, **NOT a regression**. No deploys: ms-gateway-api HEAD `e57aa65` 27d old; runtime-core `1f179c6d2` 26d old; ms-tables-fields-api `fd03a5c` 38d old.

*Playbook:* (1) confirm chronic baseline ✅ (724 vs same-window prior-day median 124, within burst-band), (2) RequestPath dominant under microservices.method.int ✅, (3) check ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota — DNS clean (no NXDOMAIN signature this cycle), (4) decision tree pending Ben's ops call: (a) raise Ocelot per-route timeout (cheap, masks), (b) scale microservices IIS pool / shorten recycle (medium), (c) profile slowest upstream (root). fix_status=needs-ops-decision **unchanged 11+ days**. Open Jira: none.
